components: Tenant or workflow identity maps each job to a scheduler shard.
A versioned map assigns shard ownership to scheduler replicas.
The owner scans and schedules only its local job subset.
Workers execute tasks without consulting unrelated scheduler shards.
Shard state transfers before a new ownership epoch becomes active.
